scope: Development-only sequence-separated FP threshold calibration; both sequences were previously explored
threshold_rule: Next representable float32 threshold above the first excluded FP score; never below 0.3. Freeze on calibration labels, rerun NMS at that threshold, require achieved calibration FPPI <= target before evaluation.
development_amendment: First attempt stopped on the exact calibration FPPI guard before evaluation: float64 nextafter rounded back in float32 comparison. Archived as failed_attempt_01.zip; threshold precision corrected before evaluation.
timing: Reuse all eligible episodes from criterion_audit_v01; new fresh run of length 3, deadline 0.2 s, horizon 0.5 s
limitations: Neither sequence is a pristine held-out test set; this is a new declared development analysis.
Matching calibration FPPI does not ensure matching evaluation FPPI.
The floor excludes thresholds below 0.3; this is not an exhaustive ROC or optimal detector calibration.
One evaluation sequence supports no sequence-generalization confidence interval.
No DSEC training, importance/hybrid results, efficiency claim or H1/H2/H3 verdict.
